description: Retention and alterations of a metal fence and a sliding gate to front garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The retention and alterations of a metal fence and a sliding gate to front garden hereby approved shall be implemented on site no later than 3 months of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ELV 02/A, ELV 04/A, SEC 01/A and GFP 01/A [received 7 February 2020], ELV 01 and ELV 03 and supporting information (special circumstances letter and evidence) [received 10 December 2019] and Site Location Map, Existing Plan and Cover Letter [received 28 October 2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The fencing and sliding gate to front garden hereby approved, as indicated on proposed drawings (ELV 02/A, ELV 04/A, SEC 01/A and GFP 01/A) shall be removed no later than 3 years of this decision and front garden boundary treatment shall be re-instated to no higher than 1m adjacent to public highway.
